findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "cred-mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_balance, get_transactions, refund_credits, get_users, request_wallet_challenge · Private data: update_user, delete_user, create_checkout_session, x402_supported, buy_credits_x402, list_x402_receipts, set_user_wallet, get_user_wallet, request_wallet_challenge, verify_wallet_signature, list_deposits · Public sink: get_balance, issue_credits, get_transactions, create_user, get_users, update_user, cancel_subscription, update_subscription_quantity, create_subscription_portal_link, verify_wallet_signature · Destructive: update_user, delete_user, delete_pricing_tier, delete_saved_payment_method, delete_auto_topup, execute_swap, get_referral_settings.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_balance, get_transactions, refund_credits, get_users, request_wallet_challenge · Private data: update_user, delete_user, create_checkout_session, x402_supported, buy_credits_x402, list_x402_receipts, set_user_wallet, get_user_wallet, request_wallet_challenge, verify_wallet_signature, list_deposits · Public sink: get_balance, issue_credits, get_transactions, create_user, get_users, update_user, cancel_subscription, update_subscription_quantity, create_subscription_portal_link, verify_wallet_signature · Destructive: update_user, delete_user, delete_pricing_tier, delete_saved_payment_method, delete_auto_topup, execute_swap, get_referral_settings

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
